name: Extra Theology Points
body:
The arts of pale theology come naturally to you.

Prerequisite(s): Theology points class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra 2 theology points each day.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, granting you an additional 2 theology points for each selection.
